newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stock board objects to warrants on index.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stock board objects to warrants on index.

text.p: Taiwan Stock Exchange Corp on Wednesday issued a statement to express "serious concern and objection" over plans by two foreign institutions to set up warrants linked to the Taiwan stock index.

"Hong Kong Peregrine Derivative Ltd and Union Bank of Switzerland will list its issued warrants, based on Taiwan Stock Exchange's weighted stock index, on the Hong Kong exchange today," the statement said.

"Because these companies have not been authorised by the Taiwan Stock Exchange to use its index, the exchange has issued an urgent letter to the two firms to express serious concern and objection and reserve the rights for necessary legal actions," the statement said.
It said the Taiwan Stock Exchange's weighted index was the company's proprietary product.
Peregrine announced on April 2 it had launched 200 million warrants on the Taiwan Stock Exchange weighted index to be listed on Hong Kong's stock exchange.
Peregrine's warrant has an exercise price at NT$8,228 or at 8,228 points of the Taiwan weighted index.
The Taiwan weighted index surged on Wednesday to end up 146.32 points, or 1.74 percent at 8,576.94. -- Taipei Newsroom
